prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: finished, extraordinary title wordmark for the premium meditative microscopic strategy game MICROVERSE. Create ONE logo, not a brand board or mockup. Wide horizontal composition, true transparent alpha background, generous clean margins, the entire logo visible.

Exact and ONLY text: "MICROVERSE". Spell all ten letters correctly, on ONE line. No tagline, no other writing.

Art direction: breathtaking biological elegance, natural pond-water microscopy translated into beautifully crafted game-title typography. A memorable, professionally designed wordmark with a clean and confident silhouette. Substantial custom uppercase letterforms, a little wide, rounded optical curves paired with finely tapered angular terminals; refined proportions and carefully balanced kerning. The M and V have elegant pointed inner cuts. It must read instantly at thumbnail size. Typography is the hero.

Material: the letters themselves are translucent living glass membranes, luminous pearl-white and pale ice blue along their delicate double refractive edges, deeper teal and desaturated blue cytoplasm within. Remarkably intricate photographic microtexture, fine intracellular strands and restrained tiny vesicles visible inside the strokes, beautiful natural differential-interference microscopy detail. Clear silvery edges and softly filled pale blue strokes provide excellent legibility over a dark blue-green dish. Make the O the restrained signature: a slightly organic circular cell-ring with a few minute warm amber organelles embedded within its thick rim, keeping its central opening visibly open so it reads unmistakably as O. A few very fine cilia along parts of that O's outer edge, barely extending beyond the letter, add a feeling of life. The rest of the word stays typographically disciplined and uncluttered.

Lighting: cool transmitted light, liquid refraction, subtle spectral pearl glints at selected membrane edges. Sophisticated depth without heavy extrusion or cast shadows. The letters should feel alive, precious, tangible, and mysterious. Exquisite biological detail with calm restraint, like a beautiful microscopic world discovered rather than a fantasy weapon logo.

Avoid: generic widely spaced thin sans-serif, chrome metal, stone, medieval lettering, horror slime, bubbly cartoon type, neon outlines, electric lightning, lens flares, giant glow halos, beveled esports logo, swirling ornament, extra organism mascots around the text, circular emblem behind the whole title, giant subtitle, background plate, rectangle, scene, opaque background, watermarks. This is a usable standalone transparent title asset, not a screenshot of a title screen. Render at the highest practical resolution in a wide landscape aspect ratio, roughly 3:1.
